src/utils/pool.ts.reason: Pre-sizing is an optimisation only: every index 0..length-1 is claimed exactly once by a worker and assigned, so new Array() ends with identical length and contents.

src/utils/file-path.ts.reason: Both arms produce the same string when `extra` is empty: `[rootCwd, ...[]].join(' or ')` === `rootCwd`. The early-return arm is a readability shortcut, not a behavioural branch, so forcing the condition either way leaves the output identical for every input.

src/utils/incremental-cache.ts.reason: Dropping the cache-miss guard makes copyFileSync throw ENOENT, which the surrounding catch already swallows; no file is created either way, so the observable state is identical.

src/utils/path-safety.ts.reason: The tie branch is unreachable: two DIFFERENT roots of equal path length cannot both be ancestors of the same directory, and an identical root reassigns the same value. `>` and `>=` therefore always agree.

src/core/estimate.ts.reason: `source` is declared `let source = ''` four lines above, so a readFileSync failure leaves it holding that initialiser already — the catch's `source = ''` is a defensive re-assignment that cannot change any state. Emptying the block is equivalent. Same shape as the catch blocks at triage/audit-one.ts:273 and :287.
